name: Tower of Hercules
description: Rising 55 metres above a rocky headland at the edge of A Coruña in north-western Spain, the Tower of Hercules is a lighthouse first built by the Romans in the late 1st century. It is the only ancient lighthouse still standing and still guiding ships. Its lower 34 metres are original Roman stonework, topped by an 18th-century restoration. Sculptures and Iron Age rock carvings surround it.
